integrity: The proof reduces the graph to a disjoint union of complete and complete bipartite components indexed by additive inverse classes of the finite field R/P. Direct modular-ring computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite commutative rings and prime ideals.
No extension is claimed for multiplicative-prime subsets that are not ideals.
The result determines total and paired domination and enumerates minimum witnesses; it does not classify automorphism orbits of those witnesses.
The foundational decomposition is published prior work; the new content is its complete strengthened-domination consequence and minimum-witness enumeration.
title: Total and paired domination in generalized total graphs at prime ideals
